home_seo_title: Medora | Ayyukan asibitin kwantar da hankali ga kowane ƙungiyar kulawa
home_seo_description: Medora EMR ne na asibiti da yawa don rajista, ziyara, aikin asibiti, ƙididdiga, da gudanarwa. Ɗayan na'ura mai laushi mai laushi don masu mallaka, ma'aikata, da benayen kulawa.
home_hero_headline: Juya kwanakin asibiti zuwa kwanciyar hankali, gudana mai alaƙa
home_hero_body: Medora: ayyuka na kulawa da asibitoci da yawa tare da rajista, ziyarce-ziyarce, benches na asibiti, da kaya a cikin na'ura mai ba da izini ɗaya.
home_how_lead: Guda ɗaya don tafiya-shiga da kulawa. Gina don lokacin ƙungiyoyi a zahiri suna motsa marasa lafiya.
home_how_step1_body: Ɗauki ainihi, allergies, da tarihi sau ɗaya. Kowace ziyara daga baya tana sake amfani da ginshiƙi ɗaya.
home_how_step2_body: Ƙirƙiri ziyarar OP ko IP, haɗa alƙawura, kuma kiyaye yanayin reshe a bayyane ga ƙasa.
home_how_step3_body: Mahimmancin ma'aikatan jinya, bincike-bincike, odar magunguna, da takardu suna rayuwa akan jadawalin ziyarar iri ɗaya.
home_how_step4_body: Abubuwan ƙira, ɓangarorin lissafin kuɗi, da matakan fitarwa sun kasance suna da alaƙa da rikodin ziyarar.
home_modules_lead: Fakitin iyawa suna rufe teburan da dole ne su kasance cikin aiki tare: ofis na gaba, benayen asibiti, kantuna, da mai gudanarwa.
home_modules_registration_body: Maigidan haƙuri, ziyartar ƙirƙira, alƙawura, da shiga sane da reshe.
home_modules_clinical_body: Ƙungiyoyin jinya da shawarwari tare da mahimman bayanai, bincike, umarni, da bayanan EMR.
home_modules_inventory_body: Stores, batches, PR/PO/GRN, yawan amfani da sashen, da faɗakarwar hannun jari.
home_modules_admin_body: Ma'aikata, rassan, ƙungiyoyin masu amfani, masters, takardu, da saitin asibiti.

pricing_who_lead: Platform, asibiti, ma'aikata, da marasa lafiya kowanne yana samun tsayayyen hanya. Zaɓi Cloud ko On-premise, sannan matakin ɗaya wanda yayi daidai da yawan asibitoci da kayayyaki da kuke gudanarwa.
pricing_who_platform_body: Ma'aikatan da suka shuka asibitoci da yawa kuma suna buƙatar alamar fari da SSO. Zaɓi Platform akan Cloud ko Kan-gida.
pricing_who_hospital_body: Masu mallaka da manajoji suna daidaita rassa, shaguna, samun damar ma'aikata, da mashahurai. Kasuwanci ko Sikeli ya dace da yawancin rukunin rukunin yanar gizo.
pricing_who_staff_body: Ma'aikatan jinya, likitoci, da ƙungiyoyin kantin sayar da kayayyaki akan abubuwan da suka san rawar gani. Ma'aunin ma'auni na wurin zama tare da shirin; marasa lafiya basu taba ganin ofishin baya ba.
pricing_who_patients_body: Charts, ziyara, da takaddun zama tare da asibiti. Ma'aikata suna aiki daga na'ura wasan bidiyo ta hanyar rajista ta kusa.
pricing_faq_q1: Shin farashin kowane ziyara ne ko kowane wurin zama na ma'aikata?
pricing_faq_a1: Matakan da aka buga su ne kowane rukunin asibiti tare da iyakoki na asibiti. Cloud and On-premise suna raba Farawa, Kasuwanci, Sikeli, da Platform. Jerin kan-jigon kowane wata shine Cloud + $150. Babu wani yanayi yana amfani da mitar ziyarar-kowace wanda ke tashi a ranakun aiki.
pricing_faq_q2: Me yasa ake ajiye kashi 20% na shekara?
pricing_faq_a2: Makullin lissafin shekara-shekara a cikin shekara mai iya faɗi na Medora. Asibitin salon Loomline SaaS sau da yawa yana rangwame tsare-tsaren shekara kusan 15 zuwa 20%. Medora yana aiwatar da kashi 20% daga jerin kowane wata lokacin da kuke biyan kowace shekara, don duka Cloud da Kan-gida (bayan + $ 150 akan-premise premise).
pricing_faq_q3: An haɗa kaya da kayan aikin asibiti?
pricing_faq_a3: Mai farawa ya haɗa da ainihin rajista, ziyartan, da benches na asibiti tare da kayan asali na asali. Kasuwanci da sama suna buɗe cikakkun hanyoyin sarrafa kaya, umarnin magunguna da ke da alaƙa da haja, da ingantaccen tsarin gudanarwa. Tambayi lokacin da kuke buƙatar ingantattun add-ons.
pricing_faq_a4: Yi amfani da jujjuyawar kasuwa sama da tsare-tsaren. Duniya yana nuna USD kawai. Myanmar yana nuna MMK a 1 USD = 5000 MMK (tare da USD a matsayin layi na biyu). Lokacin lissafin kuɗi da yanayin sabis sun bambanta da kasuwa.
pricing_faq_a5: Ana karbar bakuncin Cloud Medora: SaaS na asibiti da yawa, sabuntawar sarrafawa, da farawa cikin sauri. Kan-gida yana amfani da matakan hawa iri ɗaya, wanda aka sanya akan ababen more rayuwa lokacin da kuke buƙatar sarrafawa ko wurin zama. Infra naku ne; Jerin kowane wata shine Cloud + $150 don wannan alhakin.

admin_icd_subtitle: Browse WHO ICD-10, US ICD-10-CM, and WHO ICD-11 diagnosis codes used by EMR pickers. Each edition is a separate catalogue. Reseed imports the active tab (WHO ICD-API or CDC ICD-10-CM).
admin_icd_empty: No ICD codes match these filters.
admin_icd_reseed_confirm: Import the full catalogue for {system}? This can take a long time. Existing codes are upserted by code so diagnosis links stay valid. WHO editions need WHO_ICD_CLIENT_ID and WHO_ICD_CLIENT_SECRET. ICD-10-CM downloads from CDC.
admin_icd_reseed_success: ICD import finished. Inserted {inserted}, updated {updated}, total {total}.
admin_icd_reseed_hint: WHO tabs walk the WHO ICD-API (ICD-10 2019 / ICD-11 MMS). The ICD-10-CM tab imports CDC order files. Register WHO keys at https://icd.who.int/icdapi. CLI: pnpm db:import:icd -- --system ICD10|ICD11|ICD10_CM|WHO|ALL.
icd_cm_attribution: ICD-10-CM is the US clinical modification published by CDC/NCHS. It is stored as a separate catalogue from WHO ICD-10.
